caption: The drawing features two horizontal bars, each with four circular medallions hanging from short loops beneath them. The illustration is rendered in black and white pencil or ink on a beige background. On the upper bar, the four medallions have different engraved designs: the first shows a rooster in profile standing in a farmyard setting, the second displays an artist's palette and brushes, the third features the head of a cow, and the fourth depicts a pair of clasped hands surrounded by rays. On the lower bar, the four medallions each contain elaborate and ornate monogram letters, possibly initials, surrounded by decorative scrollwork. The drawing contains light shading, crosshatching, and line work to indicate texture and form. The bottom right corner of the paper is signed "H.A. Marsh." All objects are centered within a rectangular border that frames the composition on a lightly toned sheet.
title: Friendship Pin
